confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors have the best support from several sources, though their dates are mixed relative to the July 2026 window. Cappuccino and draft beer conflict between crowd-sourced city-level figures and higher national averages, so they are bounded estimates. Cocktail follows reported bar price ranges. wine_glass has no direct per-glass source and follows the local beer relationship. Peso-quoted figures were converted at an approximate, unverified rate. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches or listings were checked. The FX observation came from RBA search results, not the F11.1 table itself, and no 19 November figure was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors rest on city-level restaurant and drink price ranges reported in the searches; wine_glass is set from the local beer relationship because no per-glass price was found; accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of the city's hostel and hotel tiers.
